friend.definition: Someone you know well and enjoy spending time with.

best-friend.definition: A person's closest and most trusted companion, linked by emotional closeness, mutual loyalty, and a lasting friendship.

acquaintance.definition: Someone you know, but usually not very well.

classmate.definition: Someone who studies in the same class as you.

colleague.definition: Someone who works with you, usually in the same organization.

teammate.definition: A fellow member of a team.

roommate.definition: An associate who shares a room with you.

pen-pal.definition: A friend with whom someone regularly exchanges letters or messages, often while living far away.
pen-pal.exampleUsage: She writes monthly letters to her pen pal.

companion.definition: A friend who is frequently in the company of another.

partner.definition: Someone you share a relationship, activity, or responsibility with.

husband.definition: A married man in relation to his spouse.

wife.definition: A married woman in relation to her spouse.

girlfriend.definition: A woman in a romantic relationship with someone.

fianc-.definition: A man who is engaged to be married.
fianc-.exampleUsage: Her fiancé attended the family celebration.

fianc-e.definition: A woman who is engaged to be married.
fianc-e.exampleUsage: His fiancée joined the planning meeting.

significant-other.definition: A person's partner in a close committed relationship, without specifying marriage or gender.
significant-other.exampleUsage: The form allows a guest to list a significant other.

soulmate.definition: A person you love deeply and feel is right for a lasting romantic relationship.

boss.definition: The person in charge of workers or a workplace.

manager.definition: A person responsible for organizing the work of a business, team, or department.

employee.definition: A worker who is hired to perform a job.

supervisor.definition: Someone who oversees other people's work.

intern.definition: A student or trainee working temporarily to gain experience.

mentor.definition: An experienced person who guides and supports someone else.

apprentice.definition: A person learning a skilled job through supervised work and training.

assistant.definition: A person who contributes to the fulfillment of a need or furtherance of an effort or purpose.

director.definition: A person who leads an organization or manages a particular activity.

coordinator.definition: Someone whose task is to see that work goes harmoniously.

student.definition: A person who studies at a school.

coach.definition: A person who trains a team or helps someone improve a skill.

captain.definition: The leader of a sports team, or the person in command of a ship.

leader.definition: A person who rules or guides or inspires others.

volunteer.definition: A person who freely helps without being paid.

member.definition: One of the persons who compose a social group (especially individuals who have joined and participate in a group organization).

president.definition: The leader of a country, organization, or group.

secretary.definition: An assistant who handles correspondence and clerical work for a boss or an organization.

treasurer.definition: An officer charged with receiving and disbursing funds.
